name: What causes mold to grow around windows?

mainEntity.name: What causes mold to grow around windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold around windows typically results from excess moisture and condensation. Windows are often cooler than interior walls, causing water vapor in the air to condense on the glass and frame. Poor ventilation, high indoor humidity, leaks in the window seal or frame, and improper drainage can all contribute to this moisture buildup, creating an ideal environment for mold spores to thrive. Regular cleaning and managing indoor humidity can help prevent this issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold around windows is caused by excess moisture and condensation, often due to temperature differences, poor ventilation, or leaks.
